title: Axioms of Zero Dimension
axioms: A0 Existence: There exists a zero-dimensional coherent presence Φ₀.
A1 No extent: Φ₀ has neither spatial nor temporal extension.
A3 Collapse of coordination: ∀ N,T ≥ 1, C(N,T,1) = 0.
A4 Priority: Φ₀ is prior to spacetime; spacetime is Residual(Φ₀).
A5 Permanent flag: Once recorded (genesis hash), C ≡ 0 must never be re-derived.
A6 Service: The root is defined to serve the least among us.
